mapper.select: select count(*) from t_message where state = 0 and deleteState = 0 and receiveUserId = #{receiveUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select p.id as p_id, p.avatarUrl as p_avatarUrl, p.nickname as p_nickname, p.username as p_username, p.gender as p_gender, r.id as r_id, r.avatarUrl as r_avatarUrl, r.nickname as r_nickname, r.username as r_username, r.gender as r_gender, m.id, m.postUserId, m.receiveUserId, m.content, m.state, m.deleteState, m.createTime, m.updateTime from t_message m left join t_user p on m.postUserId = p.id left join t_user r on m.receiveUserId = r.id where m.deleteState = 0 and m.receiveUserId = #{receiveUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} order by m.createTime desc, m.state asc

select p.id as p_id, p.avatarUrl as p_avatarUrl, p.nickname as p_nickname, p.username as p_username, p.gender as p_gender, r.id as r_id, r.avatarUrl as r_avatarUrl, r.nickname as r_nickname, r.username as r_username, r.gender as r_gender, m.id, m.postUserId, m.receiveUserId, m.content, m.state, m.deleteState, m.createTime, m.updateTime from t_message m left join t_user p on m.postUserId = p.id left join t_user r on m.receiveUserId = r.id where m.deleteState = 0 and m.postUserId = #{postUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT} order by m.createTime desc

select p.id as p_id, p.avatarUrl as p_avatarUrl, p.nickname as p_nickname, p.username as p_username, p.gender as p_gender, r.id as r_id, r.avatarUrl as r_avatarUrl, r.nickname as r_nickname, r.username as r_username, r.gender as r_gender, m.id, m.postUserId, m.receiveUserId, m.content, m.state, m.deleteState, m.createTime, m.updateTime from t_message m left join t_user p on m.postUserId = p.id left join t_user r on m.receiveUserId = r.id where m.deleteState = 0 and ((m.postUserId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and m.receiveUserId = #{peerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) or (m.postUserId = #{peerId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and m.receiveUserId = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT})) order by m.createTime asc, m.id asc
